I’m shocked that there are only 5 reviews here. I can honestly say that this service is one of the best investments I’ve ever made in my life. To really get to know your body and to sit with someone who is passionate about teaching you about your body and how to treat it right and reach your goals is something special, something that would probably cost hundreds of dollars and possibly 1,000+ back home. (USA)

If you come to this area of Phuket you probably have fitness goals, and you may get advice from influencers or whatever on social media and YouTube on how to get the results you want with your fitness and body, but our bodies are different and unique, what one person may need to reach a similar goal as yours may be completely different than you need (calories, macros, specific workout routine etc.) so by following the advice of what works for one person may leave you spinning your wheels and getting no where, it’s very frustrating.

So because our bodies are different and unique, we need something customized to our needs if we are going to reach our fitness goals without wasting precious time we can’t get back. That’s what this service gives you, one on one time with a professional who will analyze your body with the best equipment available and break everything down to you so you can understand it and move forward.

If you are serious about your health, don’t skip this. It’s worth every baht, dollar or whatever, you came all this way to change for the better and I can’t think of a better way to start than here. Good luck 🙏

For everyone coming to train in Chalong, you absolutely must start your stay at this place. Accompanied by an extremely professional and experienced physiotherapist, you can have your body fully scanned in just a few minutes and receive a level of essential information to help you reach your goals.

I went there to lose weight, and thankfully I did—because their advice was crucial to my weight loss journey. The technology they use is highly advanced, unlike anything I had ever seen in Europe. I strongly recommend this place.

This should be your first stop on fitness street. They scan everything from posture, weight, fat, muscle etc etc. Then you get a chance to see where you stand and what you should work on. The guy working here will go over all of your numbers with you. And help create a nutrition plan for you. Very helpful. Thank you.

A fantastic service and great value for money. If you’re spending time on the Soi this is a great tool to track progress or even just to see where you’re at health wise.

Looking forward to visiting again
Very informative, I really recommend having the full body scan if you are into fitness or general health.

A professional and easy experience. Had the scan and by the time I changed clothing, this was ready. He went through this with me and fully explained what it meant and how I could make improvements. I would recommended this to everyone as this is the starting benchmark for me.

My Girlfriend and I came here a month ago and did 2 scans. I forgot the guy name who ran the scan, but he was awesome. He was very professional and honest about everything. I highly recommend this place if you’re ever in Phuket, do a before and after prior to training.

Great tool and easy to use.
Did a before and after along a 4 week 'body transformation' in Phuket, Thailand. …
Great service….Shad talked me through the process first,did the scan etc and then advised on training and nutrition to reach my goals.very professional and really friendly….highly recommended 💪 …
Professional, helpful & extremely knowledgeable. Can’t recommend enough!
Great place. Professional!!! helpful information. Will see you in 3 to 4 weeks to check out my progress 👍 …
